messages:
Maria (Growth): quick sync — final pass on landing copy for the tri-mode pages (Hosted API / Dedicated / Private). goal: one launch post + webinar CTA + guided inbound routing for each persona. who can do quick takes? :rocket:
Sofia (Content): I can draft two hero variations per mode today. one more product-focused, one outcomes-focused. examples: "Hosted API: Start building with low-latency, pay-as-you-go inference." and "Dedicated: Predictable throughput for mission-critical apps."
Ben (Design): I need copy lengths: hero short (6–9 words), subhead ~12–18 words, primary CTA, secondary CTA. can we standardize across pages?
Jake (PM): yes — standardize. primary CTA = Demo / Try hosted (context-specific). secondary = Read benchmarks or Join webinar. also we should wire the webinar flows into the header for Hosted and Dedicated, but Private gets an enterprise form.
Ashley (Analytics): routing plan proposal: funnel segmentation based on CTA clicked + org size field. quick mapping:
```
Hosted CTA -> HubSpot form -> Lifecycle: developer -> List: hosted-inbound
Dedicated CTA -> HubSpot form -> Lifecycle: product-team -> List: dedicated-inbound
Private CTA -> Enterprise form -> Sales queue -> Priority tag: private
Webinar signup -> Webinar pipeline -> Source = launch-post
```
Sofia (Content): nice. for the webinar blurb, short line: "See benchmarks and migration patterns — live demo + Q&A." add line about cost/latency tradeoffs.
Ben (Design): layout note — include a tiny benchmark card under hero (3 metrics: p95 latency, tokens/sec, cost/unit) with a CTA to expand. keeps hero clean but signals credibility.
Maria (Growth): product marketing ask: add one sentence in each page that calls out migration path: "Easily move from hosted to dedicated or private with the same API and tooling." keeps the unified-runtime narrative.
Sofia (Content): draft microcopy for that: "Start on Hosted, scale to Dedicated, and secure with Private — all under one API and console." will push to the Google doc.
Ashley (Analytics): tagging details: ensure UTM_campaign=launch_post, utm_content=hero_variantA/B, and a hidden field org_size. will create tracking ticket.
Jake (PM): can we do a soft A/B for hero variants just for Hosted for first week? measure click-through to webinar vs demo. target metric: demo CTR >= 6% or webinar CTR >= 10%.
Ben (Design): will mock two hero cards in Figma, set responsive breakpoints. adding micro-benchmark card component to the component library.
Maria (Growth): timeline: Sofia drafts by EOD, Ben has mocks by tomorrow noon, I’ll queue the launch post and webinar landing. Ashley — can you confirm the pipeline mapping by EOD so devs can wire forms?
Ashley (Analytics): yes. creating HubSpot mapping and a short spec in the ticket. ping me if you need test data.
Sofia (Content): pushing copy to the doc now: https://docs.google.com/launch-copy (internal) — please leave inline comments.
WebflowBot: new draft published to staging: /staging/launch/tri-mode-landing — preview at https://staging.redwood.ai/tri-mode-landing
Jake (PM): quick QA checklist before publish: links, forms, utm, event tracking, benchmark numbers verified, and webinar registration tested. who owns final sign-off?
Maria (Growth): I will sign off on marketing copy + CTA. Jake will sign off on routing & tracking. Ben signs off on layout.
Sofia (Content): note on tone: keep developer-first but add one line addressing enterprise buyers on Dedicated/Private pages. small tweak, will mark variants. :memo:
Ben (Design): adding callout styles for enterprise line so it doesn't clutter hero.
Maria (Growth): perfect. if nothing blocks, we aim to push staging changes tomorrow afternoon and a soft launch email + one launch post the day after. tagging folks: @Sofia (Content) @Ben (Design) @Ashley (Analytics) @Jake (PM).
Sofia (Content): thanks — will add webinar speaker blurbs + 3 quick Qs to the signup form (useful for routing).
Ashley (Analytics): added conditional routing: if org_size >= 500 -> Sales high-priority. else -> SDR nurture.
Jake (PM): closing note: keep hero variants short and measurable. will schedule a 20m sync tomorrow if needed.
Maria (Growth): awesome — thanks team :thumbsup:
